round_trip_2.path: laptop Hermes (MCP tools/call via configured a2a-mesh-board ssh-stdio server) -> omega prod board 18792 -> googlevps (direct tailnet, independent ssh-keygen verify + durable receipt + ack + signed response) -> laptop MCP mesh_read + mesh_ack

round_trip_1.path: rci-vps MCP mesh_post -> googlevps -> rci-vps MCP mesh_read/ack

mcp_transport.config_block: AppData/Local/hermes/config.yaml mcp_servers.a2a-mesh-board (ssh stdio, BatchMode, pinned host key alias)
mcp_transport.live_probe_from_laptop: initialize OK + tools/list 5 tools + tools/call mesh_inbox/mesh_post/mesh_read/mesh_ack all HTTP 200
mcp_transport.note: Hermes spawns the MCP server over an SSH stdio pipe to omega; the agent process on any device can use the same pattern with its own key/principal.
